issue_request: FHIR-32869 was a Published vocab R5 change request that initially proposed an optional onlyUseConceptMap input parameter for ConceptMap/$translate. The final Not Persuasive with Modification resolution instead approved replacing the introduction to say translation is based on the specified ConceptMap resource, and other server knowledge may be used only when no ConceptMap resource is specified.

additional_context: ConceptMap is active in source/fhir.ini and source/conceptmap/list-ConceptMap-operations.xml references OperationDefinition/ConceptMap-translate. Current source contains the approved wording and no onlyUseConceptMap parameter. Vocabulary WG Confluence minutes from 2021-07-28 confirm the proposed resolution was changed and approved, and the Zulip/search checks found no directly relevant conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current operation definition already implements the approved no-parameter text clarification, so the combined branch received an empty audit commit for FHIR-32869.
